Bench: Rohit Arya, Satyendra Kumar Singh  1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT GWALIOR  BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE ROHIT ARYA  &
 HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH  ON THE 21 st OF FEBRUARY, 2023  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 2753 of 2023 BETWEEN:-
THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE STATION BAIRAD, DISTRICT SHIVPURI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....APPELLANT (BY SHRI A.K. NIRANKARI-PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT GWALIOR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: AND 1. SURENDRA DHAKAD S/O SHRI JAGDISH @ BHURA DHAKAD, AGE-20 YEARS, R/O JHALWASA, POLICE STATION BAIRAD, DISTRICT SHIVPURI (MADHYA PRADESH)

2. THE PROSECUTRIX R/O VILLAGE JHALWASA, POLICE STATION BAIRAD, DISTRICT SHIVPURI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....RESPONDENT Th is appeal coming on for admission this day, JUSTICE ROHIT ARYA passed the following:
Present appeal under sub-section (2) of Section 14A of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, is directed against the judgment of acquittal dated 07.12.2022 passed by Special Judge (POCSO Act),
Shivpuri (M.P.) in Special Case No.63/2021, whereby respondent No.1 has been acquitted of the charges levelled against him under Sections 363, 366, 366A,
376(2)(t) of IPC and under Section 3/4 POCSO Act and under Section 3(2)(v) and 3(2)(va) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989.

sentences.text: We have heard learned Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of State.
We have also perused the impugned judgment.

I n the light of the findings of the Special Court which are based on critical evaluation of the evidence on record, conclusion of acquittal drawn particularly in view of paragraphs 31, 32, 33, 34, 35 and 36 to of the impugned judgment is found to be impregnable.

(ROHIT ARYA) (SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH)
